title: Slow-import warnings cannot be tied to a deploy
evidence: 2026-11-13: the server has no release at runtime, so adding release to the allow-list sends nothing. instrument.server.mjs sets none; SENTRY_RELEASE is a Docker build arg scoped to the build step (Dockerfile, deploy.yml); app/lib/app-lab-slow-envelope.server.test.ts pins no release; live Sentry node events carry no release tag. A fix needs a runtime env var or workflow change, and docs/privacy-app-addendum.md with it (PR 1630). Was: app/lib/app-routes.server.ts:131 rebuilds the App lab import slow event from an allow-list that leaves out release, by choice (US-52 AC7d, PR 1268), so a slowdown cannot be matched to the deploy that brought it
